usage: 月 (jyut6) is a noun meaning 'month', used when talking about the months of the year or a time duration.
You can use 月 after a number to specify which month, for example, ‘三月’ means 'March'.
月 can also be used to measure durations, for example, ‘兩個月’ means 'two months'.
It is common to say dates in Cantonese using 月 to indicate the month, usually followed by 日 (jat6) for day.
When 月 is used alone, it generally means 'a month' without specifying which one.
